_readme: The two road trips. Edit stories, stays and photo placement here, then run: python tools/build.py
Each stop: lat/lng is the map marker. 'via' points shape the road route on the way in (they are not shown as stops).
'after' points continue the route past the marker (loops and out-and-back drives). 'label' on a point puts its name on the map.
Photos: an id, or {id, at:[lat,lng]} to pin a photo where it was taken along the way. 'place' overrides its caption place.

trips.name: Road trip 2019
trips.title: Road trip 2019.
trips.subtitle: San Marcos to Paris, Texas, the long way around. Nine days through Texas, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah and Colorado.
story: Nine days and a lot of desert. I drove straight west out of San Marcos to the Guadalupe Mountains, went down into Carlsbad Caverns, out onto White Sands, and up to the Grand Canyon and Zion.
Then east into Colorado for Mesa Verde, and home across Texas.

trips.name: 45 days

trips.subtitle: Broken Bow, Oklahoma, to Paris, Texas, by way of the Pacific. March 1 to April 14.
story: I left a cabin in Broken Bow on the morning of March 1 and rolled into Paris, Texas, on April 14.
In between: the desert, the Sierra, Highway 1, a week with my brother in Washington, and the long way home through Glacier, Yellowstone, the Tetons and Colorado.
